evidence.detail: When neither preferred_printing_system_id nor preferred_printing is set, falls through to bare Scryfall named-card URL which returns the default (Arena) printing for Raging Goblin
get_printings() joins the set table but SELECTs only s.code and s.name; s.digital and s.set_type are not available on Printing objects
The set table schema includes digital (BOOLEAN) and set_type columns, confirming they are queryable

triage.fix_sketch: In oracle.py:get_printings() extend the SELECT to include s.digital and s.set_type. Add a new function get_non_digital_printing(c: Card) -> Printing | None that returns the first printing where digital is falsy. In image_fetcher.py:scryfall_image(), in the else branch (no preferred_printing set), call get_non_digital_printing and use its set_code in the URL if a non-digital printing exists.
triage.notes: Read-only SQL change; only affects the fallback image URL path when no preferred_printing is explicitly set. Admin-set preferred_printing overrides take precedence as before.
